targets.query: SELECT "value" FROM "lean_chart" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "chart" = 'Strategy Equity' AND "series" = 'Equity'
SELECT last("value") FROM "lean_chart" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "chart" = 'Strategy Equity' AND "series" = 'Equity'

SELECT last("quantity") AS "quantity", last("average_price") AS "avg_price", last("market_price") AS "market_price", last("holdings_value") AS "value", last("unrealized_profit") AS "pnl", last("unrealized_profit_percent") AS "pnl_pct" FROM "lean_holding" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "quantity" > 0 GROUP BY "symbol"

SELECT "fill_quantity" AS "fill_qty", "fill_price" AS "fill_price", "fee_amount" AS "fee", "quantity" AS "order_qty", "order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "lean_order_event" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "status" = 'Filled' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT last(*) FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime'
SELECT last("cash") FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT last("total_holdings_value") FROM "lean_portfolio" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live'
SELECT "numeric_value" FROM "lean_metric" WHERE time > 0 AND "algorithm_id" = '${algorithm_id}' AND "mode" = 'live' AND "category" = 'runtime' AND "metric" = 'Unrealized'
